notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi fortune-tellers! 🔮🎴

I have a quick little demo update for you:
Some of played the story and find a bug inside the story tree. Leon reacted not accordingly to your answer - but now it is fixed 💖
@Frostbite, PHOBIE, naensch: Thank you for your feedback and letting us know!!

Also the rain sounds softer in the beginning of the game and some spelling mistakes are gone.

We still have lots to do to make this a final game. So thank you for being around so early ✨
I wish you a really nice day ☘️
Anke
